payload.body: You tend to want closeness, honesty, or attention and then avoid the exact question that could bring it. The distance keeps changing because one part of you is responding to the current person and another is protecting against an earlier outcome. This often makes reasonable caution difficult to separate from automatic avoidance. Ask one question that belongs only to the situation in front of you.
payload.astroHint: Lilith quincunx Chiron can make protection from an old hurt interfere with a present desire.
payload.sourceMechanism: LIMITED LEGACY SUPPORT: no fallback-hook/aspect-pair/lilith reader row exists for this counterpart. Lilith core: The disowned, uncompromising self. Black Moon Lilith marks raw instinct that refuses to be tamed, shamed, or controlled, and the place where autonomy and unfiltered truth are reclaimed. Chiron primitive: The deep, lasting wound and the path through it. Chiron marks where a person may feel broken, not enough, or too much, and where working honestly with that wound can become medicine they later offer others. Pair frame: The healing stalls until the forbidden want is admitted; then both move. Treating the want and the wound as separate cases keeps both open. The reclaimed desire turns out to be medicine; shame dissolves when the stories are told together. Aspect operation: Quincunx puts mismatched functions together and requires repeated adjustment. Traditional nature: awkward, requires adjustment.
